rules: COMPLETE: the selected source endpoint paged to an empty cursor with zero gaps (and no page_cap / deadline / budget stop).

PARTIAL: at least one page was received from the selected source but a gap stopped the pull (e.g. /markets failed and /events stopped after page 0 -> cohort_source events_nested, cohort_completeness PARTIAL).
INCOMPLETE: no page received from any endpoint (all gaps, BUDGET_GRANT_MISSING, deadline or pause before first page).

ANY gap -> counts_label INCOMPLETE and counts_are_lower_bounds true. 0 with gaps is NOT zero: zero_with_gaps true and the report/scorecard hand-off must render it as INCOMPLETE, never as a measured 0.
Existing cohort_source values (markets_list / markets_list_partial / events_nested) are unchanged; the qualifier is a new field.
